name: Nico Hülkenberg
features: fair skin, short mid-brown hair, blue eyes, broad open face, tall athletic build, easy half-smile
bio: A Formula One driver who took a single weekend off in 2015 to share the #19 Porsche 919 with Earl Bamber and Nick Tandy, and won Le Mans at the first attempt. In Formula One he went on to hold the unwanted record for the most starts without a podium.
